first_attempt_failure.cause: Global cache bypass forced installed Torch/Python source recompilation. The correct failed terminal arrived just after the fixture wait deadline.
first_attempt_failure.repair: Restrict source-only import loader to qualification.*; retain installed runtime caches. No loss/gradient/worker math behavior changed.

resolved_defects: Retained pre-start and reservation-racing cancellation can no longer be lost; first payload binding and cancel registration are serialized.
Worker self-announces its process incarnation before training and has independent alarm/CPU/file/core limits that survive runner death.
Explicit authorized cancellation can stop a verifiable orphan using a pidfd and exact incarnation/command line; status never performs control writes or signals.
Every handoff digest and count is checked against diagnostics, retained dispatch, and actual output bytes, including previously skipped runtime, graph, and gradient identities.
Nonblocking descriptor open precedes regular-file checks, so FIFOs cannot indefinitely block receipt/source reads.
Pinned repository modules execute source instead of unpinned timestamp-valid .pyc files; installed runtime caches remain in use.
Cancellation scans and execution-source hashing have explicit count/byte bounds; JSON numeric overflow is rejected.
Lifecycle fixtures retain all job stores, logs, failures, cancellations and unknown outcomes instead of deleting their evidence.
scope: Independent Linux supervisor engineering audit; bounded local CPU fixtures only; no CUDA or scientific campaign.

test_boundaries.test_cancel_only_after_owned_worker_term: Real owned worker is cancelled only after confirmed child termination; cancellation identity and terminal receipt replay remain stable.
test_boundaries.test_cancel_serializes_with_reservation_: Concurrent cancellation cannot fall into the reservation setup gap; first binding is serialized and its cancellation remains effective.
test_boundaries.test_cli_ignores_timestamp_valid_bytecod: A deliberately stale timestamp-valid supervisor_store.pyc cannot replace the checked repository source.
test_boundaries.test_completed_orphan_outputs_are_preser: A worker completing while its runner is stopped leaves complete candidate/handoff bytes; after runner death, neither Cancel nor Start fabricates success or relaunches.
test_boundaries.test_concurrent_same_key_launches_one_wo: Three concurrent starts with the same immutable key/payload reserve one job and produce one reusable terminal result.
test_boundaries.test_dead_runner_stays_unknown_until_exp: An orphan is Unknown; read-only status adds no control records or signals; an explicit retained Cancel uses pidfd and confirms stopping; live worker CPU limit is 300 seconds.
test_boundaries.test_empty_reservation_missing_job_and_f: Missing/partial setup remains Unknown; an invalid NDU loss fails in the real worker and its failed receipt is reused, with no automatic launch.
test_boundaries.test_every_handoff_digest_and_count_matc: All 11 handoff digest slots and seven count slots are corrupted one at a time and independently rejected against retained request/diagnostics/output bytes.
test_boundaries.test_nonregular_reads_and_nonfinite_json: FIFO input is rejected before blocking open/read; JSON numeric overflow to infinity is rejected.
test_boundaries.test_prestart_cancel_binds_payload_and_s: A retained early cancel blocks a conflicting payload before job creation, cancels the matching later start before runner launch, and status is strictly observational.
test_boundaries.test_real_worker_lost_reply_reuse_cold_s: Real success survives discarded launch reply and cold queries; duplicate start reuses identity, conflicting payload is Unknown, and receipt tampering makes status Unknown without relaunch.

unknown_boundaries: Missing, incomplete, conflicting or corrupted durable identity is Unknown, never evidence that a job was absent and never automatic authority to relaunch.
Running requires both live recorded worker and runner incarnations. A live worker with a missing/dead controller remains Unknown until an explicit authorized Cancel replay or owner reconciliation.
Status is strictly read-only. It cannot write a lock, cancellation marker, reconciliation record, terminal receipt or send a signal.
Unavailable pidfd facilities, mismatched incarnation or worker command line, unreadable identity, or unconfirmed stop stay Unknown; caller-supplied PIDs are never accepted.
If completion/failed output may already exist, orphan stopping preserves it and remains Unknown instead of reporting training success or an unqualified cancellation.
Complete outputs without the owned runner terminal receipt remain Unknown even if byte identities validate; the independent owner must reconcile them.
The store is a trusted private Linux single-host authority. Source is captured per reservation and independently checked by the owner; installed package binaries are not attested by version tuples.
Per-worker 300-second wall/CPU and file/source/receipt bounds are implemented. No aggregate host concurrency, exact RSS, physical-energy or scientific-quality claim is made.
